title_original: 감사원 전문인력 및 전문직위의 운영 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in these Regulations are defined as follows:
1. "Specialized personnel" means key experts who possess both specialized knowledge concerning affairs subject to audit and auditing techniques, are selected under Article 5, and are assigned to specialized positions.
2. "Specialized position" means a position designated by the Chairperson of the Board of Audit and Inspection (hereinafter referred to as the "Chairperson") as requiring particularly high expertise and a long-term assignment.
